title: 第13章 云煌发怒第14章 回廊暗流
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
不过片刻，贾执事便战战兢兢地走了进来。见到端坐主位、面无表情的云擎，感受到那股几乎凝成实质的压迫感，不由额上见汗。
“贾执事，”云擎声音不高，却字字如冰“今日向少君禀报，你说是‘云烁与云浩起冲突，导致镇魂碑破碎’？”他重瞳锁定贾执事，洞悉一切。
贾执事身体一颤，头垂得更低：“是…是，大公子。”
“哦？”云擎尾音微扬，带着冷冽的质疑，“据本公子所知，云浩辱及庶脉挑衅在先，动手在前，怎的到了你口中，倒显得是烁儿过错更大一般？”
贾执事脸色发白，冷汗浸湿了衣衫。云擎浑身气场令人心悸，这哪还是白日在少君身旁温和恭谦的大公子？这分明是一位掌控生杀、冰冷无情的上位者！
“大公子明鉴！属…属下…”贾执事噗通一声跪倒在地，语无伦次。
云擎身体微微前倾，目光如实质般落在他身上，声音低沉充满威慑：“是谁，让你在少君面前如此‘措辞’的？想清楚再回答，少君已将此事全权交由本公子处理，若有半句虚言……”他没有说下去，但那股冰冷的杀意，让贾执事毫不怀疑，下一刻自己就会被云擎毙于掌下。
贾执事不敢再推脱隐瞒，涕泪横流地交代：“是…是云浩少爷身边的大执事！他让属下汇报时只说冲突，不提缘由，最好能让少君因此对云烁公子，乃至…乃至对大公子您心生不满！他威胁属下若不听命，五长老就将属下贬到荒城挖矿，属下是受了胁迫这才…属下糊涂！属下知错了！求大公子开恩！”
云擎听完，眼底寒光一闪而逝。呵，怕不只是受了胁迫，还许了什么好处吧？冲着五长老一脉“趋吉避凶”的名头，想提前站队投资？
就知道事情没那么简单，果然是冲他来的么。宗祠事发，他若被云煌迁怒也是理所应当，若没有，幕后之人也可以完美隐身，继续谋划他的毒计……觉得他云擎必定是“凶”？那谁又是那个“吉”？
“滚下去。”云擎声音冰冷，“今日之言，若泄露半句，休怪本公子不客气。”他指尖一弹，一道禁制咒文打入贾执事神魂上。
贾执事如蒙大赦，连连谢恩地退出去。
云擎踏出偏殿，向候在一旁的值守长老问“云浩现在何处？”
“回大公子，方才五长老亲自前来，已将云浩带往栖梧殿，说是…要向少君负荆请罪。”
……
栖梧殿主殿内。
云煌高踞主座，指尖一枚玉简流淌着微光。殿下，一名身着暗紫长袍、面容阴柔俊美的青年，正躬身汇报东域边境一处灵石矿脉的近况。
此人乃是十二长老的嫡孙，身负“噬灵体”的云魑。他言辞清晰，姿态恭谨，隐隐有几分云擎平日的风范。
就在这时，殿外传来通传，五长老携嫡孙云浩求见。
云煌眉梢微挑，淡金色的眼瞳瞥了一眼殿下的云魑。云魑立刻识趣地停下汇报，躬身道：“少君既有要事，小弟先行告退。”

“不必。”云煌声音平淡，“既是宗祠之事，你也听听。”
云魑垂首应“是”，退至一旁，眼底异色一闪而逝。
很快，满面红光、身形微胖的五长老拉着面无人色的云浩入殿，脸上满是惶恐与懊悔。
五长老深深躬身“少君恕罪！是老朽管教无方，致使这孽障冲撞宗祠，惊扰少君清静，特带他来向少君请罪！”五长老声音微颤，将姿态放得极低，他身后随从捧着数个宝光莹莹的玉盒，显然是用来赔罪的。
content_en:
Within a moment, Deacon Jia walked in tremblingly. Seeing Yun Qing sitting in the main seat with an expressionless face, he felt the pressure that was almost solid, and he couldn't help but sweat on his forehead.
"Deacon Jia," Yun Qing's voice was low but his words were as clear as ice, "Today I reported to Shaojun, you said that 'Yun Shuo and Yun Hao had a conflict, which caused the soul-suppressing monument to be broken'?" He locked his eyes on Deacon Jia and understood everything.
Deacon Jia's body trembled and his head dropped lower: "Yes...yes, eldest son."
"Oh?" Yun Qing's voice was slightly raised, with cold questioning, "As far as I know, Yun Hao humiliated and provoked the concubine first, and took action first. How come it seems to you that Shuo'er is at the greater fault?"
Deacon Jia's face turned pale and his clothes were soaked with cold sweat. Yun Qing's aura was so frightening that he was still the gentle and courteous young master who was beside Shaojun during the day. This is clearly a cold and ruthless superior who controls life and death!
"Master Mingjian! I'm... my subordinate..." Deacon Jia fell to his knees with a thud, speaking incoherently.
Yun Qing leaned forward slightly, his gaze fell on him like a real person, and his voice was low and full of intimidation: "Who asked you to 'word' like this in front of Shaojun? Think carefully before answering. Shaojun has given full authority to this young master to handle the matter. If there are any false words..." He did not continue, but the cold murderous intention left Deacon Jia without any doubt that he would be killed by Yun Qing in the next moment.
Deacon Jia did not dare to shirk the secret anymore, and confessed with tears streaming down his face: "It's... the chief deacon beside Master Yunhao! When he asked his subordinates to report, he only talked about the conflict without mentioning the reason. It would be best for the young master to treat Master Yun Shuo because of it, or even To the extent that he is dissatisfied with you, the eldest son! He threatened that if his subordinates did not obey his orders, the fifth elder would demote them to the deserted city for mining. This subordinate was forced to do so... I am confused! Please forgive me, eldest son!"
After Yun Qing heard this, a cold light flashed in his eyes. Heh, I'm afraid it's not just coercion, but also any benefits? Do you want to join the ranks of the Five Elders and invest in advance?
I knew it wasn't that simple. It was really for him. When the incident at the ancestral hall happened, it would be natural for him to be angered by Yun Huang. If not, the person behind the scenes could be perfectly invisible and continue to plan his vicious plan... Do you think Yun Qing must be "fierce"? So who is the "lucky"?
"Get out of here." Yun Qing's voice was cold. "If even a single word of what I said today is leaked, don't blame me for being rude." With a flick of his fingertip, a forbidden spell penetrated Deacon Jia's soul.
Deacon Jia felt like he had been pardoned and left with thanksgiving.
Yun Qing stepped out of the side hall and asked the elder on duty who was waiting aside, "Where is Yunhao now?"
"Back to the eldest son, the fifth elder has just come in person and has taken Yunhao to Qiwu Hall, saying that... he wants to apologize to the young master."
…
In the main hall of Qiwu Hall.
Yunhuang is sitting high on the main seat, with a jade slip on his fingertips shining with light. Your Highness, a young man wearing a dark purple robe with a feminine and handsome face, is bending down to report on the current situation of a spiritual stone mine on the border of the Eastern Region.
This person is the direct grandson of the Twelve Elders, Yun Chi, who carries the "Spirit Devouring Body". His words were clear, his posture was respectful, and he had a hint of Yun Qing's usual demeanor.
At this moment, a message came from outside the palace that the fifth elder and his grandson Yunhao were asking for an audience.
Yun Huang raised his eyebrows slightly and glanced at His Highness Yun Chi with his pale golden eyes. Yun Chi immediately stopped his report and bowed, "Young Master has something important to do, so I'll take my leave first."
"No need." Yunhuang's voice was calm, "Since it is a matter of the ancestral hall, you should also listen."
Yun Chi lowered his head in response, "Yes" and stepped aside, with a strange color in his eyes.
Soon, the red-faced and slightly fat Fifth Elder pulled the pale-faced Yunhao into the palace, his face full of fear and regret.
The Fifth Elder bowed deeply, "Young Master, please forgive me! It was my incompetence in discipline that caused this evil obstacle to crash into the ancestral hall and disturb Young Master's peace. I brought him here to apologize to Young Master!" Five EldersThe elder's voice trembled slightly, and his posture was very low. The entourage behind him held several jade boxes with shining lights, which were obviously used to apologize.
